reason: Making the job-rejected fixture emittable under D6/D7 would require rewriting its evaluator log, maker log, custody inputs and event ledger so every hand-entered time matches a logged call, and it would still break the E3/T7b case that deliberately exercises missing logger times on that same fixture. Moving the emit-success checks to a fixture that already supplies real logger times localizes the break to one test file and preserves the existing refusal coverage.
old_assertion: A model evaluator with no harness log emits a record with a note external about the missing log.
new_assertion: A model evaluator with no harness log refuses the record instead of taking check times from an unsourced or incomplete log.
